cohort: The cohort consisted of 392 women who gave birth at Wolaita Sodo University comprehensive and specialized hospital in Southern Ethiopia.
finding: The prevalence of primary cesarean section delivery was 28.57%, and it was significantly associated with primigravida status, fetal distress, and fetal macrosomia, while partograph utilization was negatively associated.
mod_finding: Primary cesarean section delivery was significantly more likely among primigravida mothers, those experiencing fetal distress, and mothers with fetal macrosomia, but less likely with partograph utilization.
